Subject: Post-call recap + POC plan (next steps)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as you run the trial: 

1) POC objective: Demonstrate Redwood inference reduces inference cost by >=30% at equivalent latency for your triage + summary pipeline and supports private deployment for PHI-sensitive workloads.

2) Success criteria (high level):
   - Generation latency p95 <= 350ms on 2k token context under 20qps
   - Token cost reduction >=30% vs current baseline (as measured on sample workload)
   - No regression in summary quality (BLEU/ROUGE + 5 example golden prompts)
   - KV-cache persistence for session continuity across restarts

3) Proposed evaluation plan and timeline:
   - Week 0 (this week): share evaluation dataset + access details (you)
   - Week 1: Redwood spins up dedicated trial environment + initial tuning (us)
   - Week 2: Joint validation runs, metrics collection (both)
   - Week 3: Final readout and exec decision (go/no-go)

4) Ownership:
   - Redwood AE / POC lead: me (Marissa) — overall coordination
   - Redwood SRE: Marcus Lin — environment & performance tuning
   - Acme POC lead: Sarah Johnson — dataset & evaluation sign-off

Action items for Acme: share the evaluation dataset and a short list of 5 golden prompts by EOD Friday so Marcus can begin baseline runs.

I attached a short POC evaluation plan and a success criteria spreadsheet to this thread. Let me know if you'd like to add anything or change the timeline.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
